# Attack Explorer

> Visual Cyber Attack, Log & Malware Analyzer mapped to MITRE ATT&CK.

Attack Explorer is an interactive step-by-step visual simulator and analyzer for cyber attacks, SIEM/Sysmon log analysis, and malware behavioral execution mapped to the MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise Matrix. Every published scenario pairs a bespoke real-world 3D mechanism stage, silent-lecture 2D SVG+GSAP technical clips, interactive Excalidraw chalk whiteboards, live topology flows, and synthetic Sysmon/SIEM telemetry grounded in authoritative primary vendor and government advisories.

## Core Capabilities
- **Attack Simulation:** Step-by-step visual execution of documented adversary intrusion mechanisms across Workstation, Active Directory Domain Controller, and Cloud environments.
- **Log Forensics:** Live Sysmon, Windows Event Log, Linux auditd, and SIEM telemetry correlation with defensive Sigma, YARA, Suricata, and KQL detection rules.
- **Behavioral Mapping:** Direct mapping to MITRE ATT&CK tactics, techniques, and sub-techniques (TTPs).
- **Process Memory Inspection:** Virtual Address Descriptor (VAD) memory forensics comparing signed on-disk `SEC_IMAGE` mappings against hollowed `MEM_PRIVATE` `RWX` allocations.

## Live Bespoke Scenarios (Published)
- [Process Hollowing & Cobalt Strike Beacon Loader (T1055.012)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/process-hollowing): `svchost.exe` `CREATE_SUSPENDED` spawn, `NtUnmapViewOfSection` unmapping, `VirtualAllocEx` (`RWX`) + `WriteProcessMemory` injection, `SetThreadContext` (`RCX`) + `ResumeThread` execution, and TLS 1.3 Malleable C2 beaconing (`Sysmon EID 1, 3, 10, 25`).
- [Fileless AMSI Memory Bypass & Reflective DLL Injection (T1562.001 / T1620)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/amsi-reflective-dll): `winword.exe` -> hidden encoded `powershell.exe` resolving `amsi.dll!AmsiScanBuffer` (`0x7FF9C2142840`), `VirtualProtect` (`0x20 -> 0x40`), 6-byte `E_INVALIDARG` prologue patch (`B8 57 00 07 80 C3`) + `RX` re-lock, and zero-disk `WebClient.DownloadData` + `[Assembly]::Load($bytes)` in unbacked `MEM_PRIVATE RWX` RAM (`PowerShell EID 4104`, `EtwTiLogProtectVM`, `Sysmon EID 3`, `.NET ETW EID 152`).
- [LockBit 3.0 Ransomware: Shadow Copy Wipe & High-Speed IOCP Encryption (T1486 / T1490)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/ransomware-shadow-wipe): Lateral `PsExec` staging from `JUMP-OPS-02` (`10.10.15.8`) over SMB `ADMIN$` installing `PSEXESVC` as `SYSTEM` to launch `lb3_black.exe -pass 8f91c2a0` (`PID 6412`), local VSS deletion via `vssadmin`/`wmic`/`bcdedit` and service stops (`VSS`/`sqlservr`/`VeeamBackupSvc`, `EID 7036`), 8-thread asynchronous IOCP `4 KB–64 KB` head-only `ChaCha20 + RSA-2048` encryption (`*.lockbit`, `4,820 files` in `11.4s`), `Restore-My-Files.txt` + `lb3_wall.bmp`, and `wevtutil.exe cl Security` (`PID 6618`) leaving `WinSec EID 1102` while off-host SIEM preserves the timeline.
- [Lazarus (SmoothOperator): 3CXDesktopApp Supply-Chain Attack & Gopuram (CVE-2023-29059)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/3cx-desktopapp-supply-chain-lazarus): Cascading `X_TRADER` -> 3CX CI/CD compromise swapping `ffmpeg.dll` and `d3dcompiler_47.dll` before genuine EV Authenticode signing (`v18.12.407`), `0xFEEDFACE` + RC4 (`3jB(2bsG#@c7`) decryption into unbacked `MEM_PRIVATE RWX` (`0x000001C948200000`), GitHub `IconStorages/images/main/icon12.ico` past-EOF Base64 dead-drop resolver (`akamaitechcloudservices[.]com`), and `ICONICSTEALER` browser credential theft + selective `Gopuram` backdoor caught by `Sysmon EID 7/22/3` and behavioral EDR.
- [Andres Freund, Red Hat & Kaspersky — XZ Utils (liblzma) IFUNC sshd Supply Chain Backdoor (CVE-2024-3094)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/xz-utils-cve-2024-3094-backdoor): Release-tarball-only `m4/build-to-host.m4` extracting `liblzma_la-crc64-fast.o` from `tests/files/bad-3-corrupt_lzma2.xz` into `liblzma.so.5.6.1`, transitive `sshd -> libsystemd.so.0 -> liblzma.so.5` load triggering GNU IFUNC `crc64_resolve` pre-RELRO rewrite of `.got.plt` `RSA_public_decrypt` (`0x55B2C4198048 -> 0x7F9A2143A110`), attacker-signed `Ed448` + `ChaCha20` pre-auth `system()` root RCE (`auditd SYSCALL 59`), and Andres Freund's `+508 ms` `perf record` / Valgrind discovery.
- [Microsoft Sysinternals & Splunk SURGe DFIR — LSASS MiniDump via comsvcs.dll & Sysmon EventID 10 (T1003.001)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/dfir-lsass-minidump-comsvcs-sysmon-eid10): Elevated `CORP\adm_jchen` (`SeDebugPrivilege`, Security `EID 4672`) on `WKS-ADM-07.corp.local` locates unprotected `lsass.exe` (`PID 684`), launches signed `rundll32.exe` (`PID 5412`) with `comsvcs.dll, MiniDump` / ordinal `#24` to acquire `OpenProcess(0x1010)` (`Sysmon EID 10` `CallTrace` through `comsvcs.dll` and `dbgcore.dll`), writes a `48.2 MB` `MDMP` (`4D 44 4D 50 93 A7`) full-memory snapshot to `C:\Windows\Temp\debug.dmp` (`Sysmon EID 11`), and faces offline `pypykatz` harvesting vs. `RunAsPPL = 1` (`PsProtectedSignerLsa-Light`) and VBS Credential Guard (`LsaIso.exe`).
- [Active Directory Kerberoasting & Pass-the-Hash Lateral Movement (T1558.003)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/ad-kerberoasting): Standard domain user `CORP\j.miller` on `WKS-OPS-12` enumerates SPN accounts (`MSSQLSvc/FIN-SQL01.corp.local:1433` -> `svc_sql_prod`) via LDAP TCP/389, requests a legacy RC4-HMAC (`0x17`) TGS service ticket logged in Security `EID 4769`, cracks `$krb5tgs$23$` offline via Hashcat `-m 13100` with zero account lockouts, and pivots to `FIN-SQL01` via Pass-the-Hash (`EID 4624` LogonType 3 NTLM) + remote service install (`EID 7045`) vs. AES-256 (`0x12`) gMSA hardening.
- [Zerologon — Netlogon AES-CFB8 Zero-IV Authentication Bypass & DC Machine Account Reset (CVE-2020-1472)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/zerologon-netlogon-cve-2020-1472): Unauthenticated host `10.20.40.92` sends ~256 all-zero `ClientChallenge` / `ClientCredential` pairs over MS-NRPC (`NetrServerReqChallenge` + `NetrServerAuthenticate3`, flags `0x212FFFFF` without Secure RPC) against `CORP-DC01$` exploiting AES-CFB8 with a static 16-byte all-zero IV, resets the DC machine password to empty via `NetrServerPasswordSet2` (`EID 4742`, `EID 5823/5827`), and chains DCSync (`EID 4662`) vs. KB4557222 `FullSecureChannelProtection`.
- [Active Directory DCSync — Rogue MS-DRSR DRSUAPI Replication & Event ID 4662 (T1003.006)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/dfir-dcsync-drsuapi-replication-eid4662): Compromised workstation `WKS-FIN-09` (`10.20.40.118`) abusing delegated `DS-Replication-Get-Changes` (`1131f6aa-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2`) and `DS-Replication-Get-Changes-All` (`1131f6ad-9c07-11d1-f79f-00c04fc2dcd2`) rights impersonates a peer Domain Controller over MS-DRSR (`IDL_DRSGetNCChanges`, `Opnum 3`) against `CORP-DC01` to pull `krbtgt` and `Administrator` password hashes (`EID 4662` from non-DC IP, Zeek DCE/RPC `drsuapi`).
- [Apache Log4Shell — JNDI Lookup Injection, Rogue LDAP Class Loading & RCE (CVE-2021-44228)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/log4shell-dfir): HTTP `User-Agent` carrying a JNDI lookup string reaches `APP-WEB-01` running vulnerable `log4j-core 2.14.1`, causing JVM `JndiLookup` to issue an outbound LDAP TCP/1389 request to rogue directory `198.51.100.77`, retrieve a remote Java class reference over HTTP, execute OS commands as `java.exe -> /bin/sh` (`Sysmon EID 1/3`, Suricata JNDI alert), and contrast vulnerable Log4j 2.14.1 against Log4j `2.17.1+` + egress filtering.
- [DNS Tunneling Data Exfiltration & Covert TXT/A C2 Channel (T1071.004 / T1048.003)](https://www.attackexplorer.com/scenarios/dns-tunneling-exfil): Compromised host `WKS-DEV-19` (`10.20.14.55`) chunks `finance_q4.csv` into high-entropy Base32/hex subdomain labels (`*.c2.exfil-lab.example`) tunneled via `UDP/53` through corporate recursive resolver `CORP-DNS01` (`Sysmon EID 22` + DNS analytic `EID 256`), receives base64 command replies in `TXT` records, and is caught by Shannon entropy (> 3.8), NXDOMAIN/unique-label ratio analytics, and DNS Response Policy Zone (RPZ) sinkholing.
